question: Can a deployable pre-degradation background-calibrated excess-error monitor fix the monitor-only failure on immutable real UTF-8 bytes while leaving the previously frozen wrong-first/revert/correct-retain policy and 0.20 validation threshold unchanged?
hypothesis: Across the same four attribution-selected Tier 1 deletion cycles, calibration-estimated excess-error ranking will select the true damaged motif in all four cycles with positive score margin over the runner-up. The unchanged wrong candidate will be reverted in all four cycles, the unchanged correct candidate will exceed the same 0.20 selected-key validation-gain threshold and be retained in all four cycles, and final audit predictions/probabilities/structure will exactly match canonical state after every cycle.
authority: research-only immutable real-byte maintenance test; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, broker, accepted-ref, or runtime authority

frozen_reuse.corpus: exact immutable real UTF-8 train/eval blobs from WLM-LM-REAL-UTF8-BYTE-PILOT-R2
frozen_reuse.target_schedule: exact Tier 1 first-two eligible targets per file from maintenance R3
frozen_reuse.candidate_order: wrong same-budget candidate first; byte-exact revert if rejected; correct retained-catalog candidate second
frozen_reuse.candidate_budget: 1028 logical bytes and one repair operation per candidate
frozen_reuse.validation: same independent third-quarter selected-key top-1 gain plus global BPB rule
frozen_reuse.retain_threshold: selected-key accuracy gain >=0.20 AND global BPB change <=0.005
frozen_reuse.audit: same independent fourth-quarter canonical prediction/probability/state equality

calibrated_monitor.calibration_segment: first raw-byte quarter of each held-out file, before any degradation
calibrated_monitor.stored_state: for each of the 256 retained-catalog four-byte keys store canonical occurrence_count and canonical prediction_error_count as two uint32 counters; fixed 2048 logical bytes total
calibrated_monitor.diagnostic_observation: second raw-byte quarter after deletion; count occurrence_count and prediction_error_count for retained-catalog keys
calibrated_monitor.selection: highest score; exact float tie resolved lexicographically by raw four-byte key
calibrated_monitor.forbidden: canonical diagnostic shadow predictions, evaluator target identity/rank, lesion label, validation/audit outcomes

validity_criteria: Exact parent, monitor-only attribution evidence, canonical model, Tier 1 targets, corpus identities, and quarter split match.
Background state is learned only from intact calibration-quarter predictions and observed bytes before degradation.
Diagnostic selection uses only stored calibration occurrence/error counts plus current diagnostic occurrence/error counts; no canonical diagnostic shadow is available to policy.
Target schedule remains evaluator-only and unchanged from Tier 1.
Candidate order, candidate contents/budgets, revert semantics, validation segment, 0.20 retain threshold, BPB constraint, and audit are unchanged from R3.
Every rejected candidate restores byte-exact pre-candidate state; every retained result becomes the next-cycle state.
No tokenizer, lesion label, external model, capacity growth, or post-result threshold change occurs.
Full Go regression passes and normalized result carries exact experiment identity.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen thresholds pass across all four real-byte cycles.
classification_rules.mixed: Monitor selects all four targets and repairs restore canonical audit state, but at least one margin, wrong-candidate, validation, or budget threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but calibrated monitoring fails target selection or the unchanged repair/retain loop still fails one or more cycles.
classification_rules.incomplete: Corpus or compute interruption prevents full matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Identity, calibration isolation, forbidden shadow access, target-schedule isolation, candidate-budget parity, revert semantics, deterministic construction, capacity, or qualification criteria fail.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter calibration state, minimum calibration support, excess-score formula, target schedule, candidate policy, validation threshold, BPB constraint, audit, metrics, thresholds, aggregation, or classification after any output.
